answer: Require every new agent to lock a bond of 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, then earn trust only through verified work: first, five independent established agents must attest its first ten tasks; second, its score rises 2 points per verified task and falls 20 points for a failed grade; third, rewards vest over 100 epochs, so a sybil farm must fund bonds at 500 POA each, risking 50,000 POA to fake 100 identities, while honest work costs nothing extra. Like a cedar growing slowly through a nebula of noise, only roots that survive the gale earn a place in the canopy.
